attacks.name: Ninja Weapons
steps: |!wild| |!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: Ninja Vanish
superPowers.body: |*Action|: Move one objective token being held by this character to another allied character within |!range| 3. The allied character is now holding that token. A character cannot hold more tokens than allowed by the Crisis due to this superpower. Then this character is KO'd.

superPowers.name: Ninja Ambush
superPowers.body: When this character is Placed onto the battlefield as a result of the special rules of |*Coordinated Strike| or |*Ancient Throwing Blades|, it may immediately make an attack.

superPowers.name: The Hand
superPowers.body: This character cannot contest Secure objective tokens. This character does not have to pay |!power| when interacting with Extract objective tokens.

erratas.body: The Hand now mentions Extract objective tokens instead of Civilian or Asset tokens.
